Centuries after the shipboard era, Eden is a physical city managed through the System and E=X. Its maintained infrastructure is interpreted as substantial technological support for residents, while the exact relationship between necessities and employment remains uncertain. The guarantee best guess assumes a limited internal floor without claiming unlimited abundance or a universal statute. Eiji’s network-security work is direct evidence that useful human activity continues inside the managed environment.

 The control estimate gives the System’s practical administration substantial weight while allowing the authority of human institutions and leaders. A citywide network is not assumed to erase every human decision, and artificial guidance is not the same as equal productive ownership. The modest nonworking scenario counts security, technical maintenance, care, administration and other useful roles. Broad intervals keep participation separate from the city’s paradise imagery. This point precedes the final release and shutdown; those events change access and authority but do not establish a settled successor economy with known allocation rules.

after.society: The awake compulsory testing unit at Aperture

scope.period: Chell’s active test sequence before the attempted incineration and escape
scope.population: Chell, the single living awake human test subject in the scoped sequence
scope.exclusions: Sleeping subjects, dead staff, personality cores and companion objects do not add active humans; cake is not treated as a proven material guarantee.

after.description:
Aperture’s automated facility sustains an environment in which GLaDOS assigns Chell repeated physical tests. The machinery replaces an ordinary human operating staff, but the living subject still performs an ongoing required role. The zero-variant interpretation concerns that retained compulsory activity within a technologically managed support unit, with no assertion that every scientific test is useless. The guarantee best guess is extremely weak because the provider ultimately attempts to kill the subject rather than honoring a secure claim to continued support.

 Effective command lies near autonomous machine authority during the sequence. Human institutional origins do not give Chell practical control over the facility. The central one-person nonworking scenario is zero because recurring assigned tests count as work; the alternative one is retained if the ordeal is treated only as escape activity without a sustained role. The interval is binary, not the share of time solving puzzles. Stasis and dead staff never create leisure citizens, and neither a promised cake nor later-game institutions is imported as an established welfare floor.

guarantees.basis: Attempted incineration defeats any secure continuation claim; promised rewards are not verified necessities.

control.basis: GLaDOS autonomously directs the facility relative to the living subject during the scoped sequence.

nonworking.basis: One active Chell: recurring assigned testing counts as work, central zero; alternative one is binary rather than duration or sleeping population.

after.name: Half-Life 2 (Combine-occupied Earth)

scope.period: Before the uprising and destruction of the Citadel
scope.population: Living human residents and conscious human-derived subjects under occupation
scope.exclusions: The wider alien empire is not a human demographic denominator; unconscious hardware, dead civilians and later refugee arrangements are excluded.

after.description:
Combine occupation combines advanced technical control with actual human and human-derived labor. Rations can reward cooperation or be withheld, while people are coerced into policing, service and transformed bodily roles. The guarantee best guess is therefore very weak: technological capacity has not become a secure entitlement for occupied humans. The zero-variant interpretation concerns retained dependence and labor within an advanced system, without claiming that every imposed task is technically dispensable.

 Authority belongs to the concentrated alien hierarchy and its human collaborators. The Combine is not automatically a unitary AI merely because it uses automated command and synthetic forces; the central control point uses concentrated non-AI authority by analogy, with a broad interval for machine administration. The low nonworking scenario counts assigned duties, resistance work, care and useful informal contribution. Conscious modified humans remain workers rather than hardware to remove from the denominator. The subsequent uprising changes the arrangement, and its deaths or later deprivation are not counted as a leisure dividend.

guarantees.basis: Conditional ration access and coercion undermine a secure material floor.

control.basis: A concentrated alien hierarchy with human collaborators is the central analogy; automation alone does not establish an AI sovereign.

nonworking.basis: Living human and conscious human-derived scenario counts assigned duties, care, resistance and informal work; modified bodies are not automatically non-person equipment.
